titleEnglish: Na Man Behooda Girde — Maulana Jalaluddin Rumi

verses.ar: Na man behuda girde koocha-o-bazaar mi gardam
verses.en: Not frivolously, around the alleys and bazaars, I whirl

verses.ar:
Na man behuda girde koocha-o-bazaar mi gardam
Mazak-e-ashqi daram pae didar mi gardam
verses.en:
Not frivolously, around the alleys and bazaars, I whirl
Lover's temperament I have — to have one glimpse of my Beloved, I whirl

verses.ar: Khudaya reham kun bar mann pareeshaan waar mi gardam
verses.en: O God! Have mercy on me! Disturbed, I whirl

verses.ar: Khataa kaaram gunah gaaram bahaal-e-zaar mi gardam
verses.en: I am guilty, I am sinful — in this wretched state, I whirl

verses.ar: Sharaab-e-shouq mi nousham bagird-e-yaar mi gardam
verses.en: Desire's wine I imbibe; around the Friend, I whirl

verses.ar: Sukhan mastana mi goyam bhale hushyaar mi gardam
verses.en: Intoxicated speech I utter, even while soberly, I whirl

verses.ar:
Gahe khandam gahe giriyam gahe uftam gahe khezam
Maseeha dar dilam paida wa mann beemaar mi gardam
verses.en:
Sometimes I laugh, weep sometimes; sometimes I fall, rise sometimes
Messiah in my heart I bear — and I, the infirm, whirl

verses.ar:
Bayaan jaanan inayat kun to molana-e-rumi ra
Ghulam-e-shams tabrezam qalandar war mi gardam
verses.en:
Come, O Beloved! Indulge Maulana Rumi!
Shams Tabrizi's slave I am — like a qalandar, I whirl
